notes.text: Click Update and restart — Hive installs and comes back on its own.
What’s New popup after each update, with what was added and fixed.
Hive logo in the left rail is branding now — it no longer opens the office.
Windows app, taskbar, and installer use the Hive bee instead of the Electron atom.
Installer build works with electron-builder 26 (no more invalid win config).
